blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – Nearly three centuries of enduring faith will once again unite Oponganons this November as Lapu-Lapu City marks the 291st Patronal Fiesta in honor of Nuestra Señora de Regla (Our Lady of the Rule). The city tourism office has released the general calendar of religious activities scheduled from November 7 to 28. This year’s celebration carries the theme, “Mary, Our Lady of the Rule, Listens and Cares for Her Children in this Synodal Journey.” Feast of Nuestra Señora de Regla: General schedule November 7: Opening Salvo Dawn Procession (Walk with Mary) November 12: Fluvial Procession and Opening Mass […]...
